content:
Maya: Took a photo of my new window-seat desk setup. cable management is a mild war. pic: https://imgur.com/wsdesk001
Eli: that's gorgeous. how'd you hide the power strip?
Maya: velcroed it under the bench, zip-tied the cords and routed behind a plant. temporary but tidy.
Jon: vote: genius hack or future fire hazard? react :one: genius :two: hazard
Kelsey: :one: genius — also 10/10 plant choice.
Maya: thanked the plant.
ops-bot: PSA: If you're tucking power strips under furniture, please ensure ventilation and avoid overloading circuits.
Eli: curious about wifi — is that ethernet behind the planter?
Maya: yes, flat cable through the sill. speed fine (200 Mbps down).
Jon: protip: label both ends. you'll thank yourself 6 months later.
Kelsey: planning my own setup. show-off tour tomorrow? who wants to join?
Eli: in. snacks as bribery accepted.
Maya: will bring a tupperware of cookies for the reveal.
Jon: (reacted :thumbsup: to Maya)
Kelsey: (reacted :heart: to photo)
